title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Happy Monday overlooking the Mediterranean Sea
Very Nice. What team are you covering over there?
I am Maltese. It is my first time here. Beautiful place, a lot of time to think
Have seen Vavra over there doing any advance scouting or quality control?
I have not. Been waiting for the youngest of 11 Vavras to call me back for three weeks!

He may have tried today but you are in Malta. Thinking is good as long as you don’t overthink. Try and keep your emotions out of any decisions you have to make. (Easier said than Done) Once you arrive at a decision, don’t look back, continue pressing forward.
I always appreciate your wisdom. Will call soon.
